Skilled  Construction  Workers,  Construction  Site
Supervisors,  Middle  Level  Technical  Officers  and  other
professionals  in  the  construction  industry  as  shall  be
prescribed and which shall be available for inspection free

(2)  The  registration  of  Skilled  Construction  Workers,
